## Convert Audio

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Convert audio (or the soundtrack of videos) to MP3, AAC/M4A, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, ALAC, WMA or AC-3 with bitrate, VBR, sample rate, channel and bit-depth control.

```sh
dogubako audio convert <files…> [options]
```

Id `audio.convert` · MCP `audio_convert` · Output: files · Timeout 180 min

Also found by: mp3, wav, flac, aac, m4a, ogg, opus, aiff, alac, wma, transcode, format

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Audio files. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `mp3` | One of: `mp3`, `m4a` (AAC (M4A)), `ogg` (Ogg Vorbis), `opus`, `flac` (FLAC (lossless)), `wav` (WAV (uncompressed)), `aiff`, `alac` (Apple Lossless (M4A)), `wma`, `ac3` (AC-3 (Dolby Digital)). |
| `bitrate` | `--bitrate` | integer 32–640 | `192` | Bitrate (kbit/s). Only used when `format` is one of `mp3`, `m4a`, `ogg`, `opus`, `wma`, `ac3`. |
| `vbr_quality` | `--vbr-quality` | integer 0–9 |  | Use variable bitrate instead of a fixed bitrate (MP3 / Vorbis). Only used when `format` is one of `mp3`, `ogg`. *Advanced.* |
| `sample_rate` | `--sample-rate` | choice | `keep` | One of: `keep`, `8000` (8 kHz), `11025` (11.025 kHz), `16000` (16 kHz), `22050` (22.05 kHz), `24000` (24 kHz), `32000` (32 kHz), `44100` (44.1 kHz), `48000` (48 kHz), `88200` (88.2 kHz), `96000` (96 kHz), `192000` (192 kHz). *Advanced.* |
| `channels` | `--channels` | choice | `keep` | One of: `keep`, `1` (Mono), `2` (Stereo). *Advanced.* |
| `bit_depth` | `--bit-depth` | choice | `keep` | One of: `keep` (Keep / default), `16` (16-bit), `24` (24-bit), `32` (32-bit integer), `32f` (32-bit float). Only used when `format` is one of `wav`, `flac`, `aiff`. *Advanced.* |

## Compress Audio

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Make audio files smaller by re-encoding to an efficient codec at a lower bitrate, optionally in mono (ideal for voice).

```sh
dogubako audio compress <files…> [options]
```

Id `audio.compress` · MCP `audio_compress` · Output: files · Timeout 180 min

Also found by: reduce size, smaller, shrink, bitrate, voice memo, podcast

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Audio files. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `level` | `--level` | choice | `balanced` | One of: `light` (Light (160 kbit/s)), `balanced` (Balanced (128 kbit/s)), `strong` (Strong (96 kbit/s)), `voice` (Voice (48 kbit/s mono)). |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `mp3` | One of: `mp3`, `m4a` (AAC (M4A)), `opus` (Opus (best quality per size)). |
| `mono` | `--mono` | boolean | `false` | Downmix to mono (halves the size of stereo audio). |

## Normalize Audio

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Normalize loudness with two-pass EBU R128 (loudnorm: measure, then apply to a target LUFS / true peak / LRA) or peak-normalize to a dBFS level.

```sh
dogubako audio normalize <files…> [options]
```

Id `audio.normalize` · MCP `audio_normalize` · Output: files · Timeout 180 min

Also found by: loudness, lufs, ebu r128, loudnorm, volume leveling, peak, podcast, spotify, youtube

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Audio files. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `mode` | `--mode` | choice | `loudness` | One of: `loudness` (Loudness (EBU R128)), `peak`. |
| `preset` | `--preset` | choice | `streaming` | One of: `streaming` (Streaming (−14 LUFS)), `podcast` (Podcast (−16 LUFS)), `broadcast` (Broadcast EBU R128 (−23 LUFS)), `custom`. Only used when `mode` is `loudness`. |
| `target_lufs` | `--target-lufs` | number -70–-5 | `-16` | Only used when `preset` is `custom`. |
| `true_peak` | `--true-peak` | number -9–0 | `-1.5` | True peak (dBTP). Only used when `mode` is `loudness`. *Advanced.* |
| `lra` | `--lra` | number 1–50 | `11` | Loudness range (LU). Only used when `mode` is `loudness`. *Advanced.* |
| `peak_db` | `--peak-db` | number -30–0 | `-1` | Peak level (dBFS). Only used when `mode` is `peak`. |

## Reduce Noise

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Reduce background hiss and hum with FFmpeg's FFT denoiser (afftdn) or non-local-means (anlmdn), plus optional high-/low-pass filters.

```sh
dogubako audio denoise <files…> [options]
```

Id `audio.denoise` · MCP `audio_denoise` · Output: files · Timeout 180 min

Also found by: noise reduction, hiss, hum, background noise, clean audio, afftdn, anlmdn, rumble

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Audio files. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `method` | `--method` | choice | `afftdn` | One of: `afftdn` (FFT denoise (adaptive)), `anlmdn` (Non-local means). |
| `strength` | `--strength` | choice | `medium` | One of: `light`, `medium`, `strong`. |
| `highpass` | `--highpass` | number 0–2000 | `80` | Remove rumble below this frequency. |
| `lowpass` | `--lowpass` | number 0–24000 | `0` | Low-pass (Hz, 0 = off). *Advanced.* |
| `noise_floor` | `--noise-floor` | number -80–-20 | `-50` | Noise floor (dB). Only used when `method` is `afftdn`. *Advanced.* |
